title: TEJAURA Tool Contract
description: Schema for a modular TEJAURA tool capability, its input/output schema references, permission scope, and risk level.

description.description: Plain-language explanation of what the tool does and its side effects.

category.description: Functional category aligned with TEJAURA permission policy domains.

input_schema_ref.description: URI or repository-relative reference to the tool's input JSON Schema.

output_schema_ref.description: URI or repository-relative reference to the tool's output JSON Schema.

permission_scope.description: Least-privilege capability scope required to invoke this tool (e.g., fs:read:workspace, model:invoke:local-llama).

risk_level.description: Risk classification governing review and approval gate requirements.

enabled.description: Whether the tool is enabled for policy-checked invocation.

schema_version.description: Optional semantic version of this tool contract.
